description: Reference catalog of 62 documented cyber-operations, surveillance, censorship, and defensive methods across 10 categories, each linked to public sources. Descriptive documentation only — no operational or exploit instructions.

methods.title: Bulk Internet Metadata Collection
methods.description: Large-scale automated harvesting of metadata (sender, receiver, timestamps, duration) from emails, calls, and messages across telecom networks.

methods.title: Fiber-Optic Cable Tapping
methods.description: Physical or logical interception of data flowing through undersea and terrestrial fiber-optic backbone cables to capture raw internet traffic in transit.

methods.title: Upstream Traffic Collection
methods.description: Intercepting data directly from internet backbone infrastructure (major switches, routers, and cables) rather than from individual endpoints.

methods.title: SMS/MMS Bulk Collection & Analysis
methods.description: Mass harvesting of text messages globally, searchable by phone number, keyword, content, geolocation, and contact graphs.

methods.title: Full-Take Content Storage
methods.description: Capturing and storing the complete content of communications (not just metadata) in large data buffers for retrospective analysis.

methods.title: Legal Wiretap Backdoors in Telecom Architecture
methods.description: Mandated backdoors built into telecom switching equipment to allow lawful interception, which can be exploited by unauthorized parties.

methods.title: IoT Device Exploitation for Reconnaissance
methods.description: Compromising internet-connected cameras, sensors, and smart devices to gather intelligence, conduct surveillance, or map physical environments.

methods.title: Compromised Security Camera Networks
methods.description: Leveraging internet-connected cameras lacking encryption and security controls on critical infrastructure networks to conduct espionage.

methods.title: Credential Phishing Campaigns
methods.description: Crafting convincing fake login pages or emails to steal usernames and passwords from high-value targets (officials, executives, researchers).

methods.title: Telecom Network Infiltration
methods.description: Long-term persistent access inside telecommunications providers' internal networks to intercept calls, messages, and subscriber data.

methods.title: University & Research Network Exploitation
methods.description: Targeting academic institutions to access research data, intellectual property, and as pivot points to other networks.

methods.title: Supply Chain Compromise (Hardware)
methods.description: Embedding surveillance or exfiltration capabilities into hardware components (chips, cameras, networking equipment) during manufacturing.

methods.title: Supply Chain Compromise (Software)
methods.description: Injecting malicious code into legitimate software updates or dependencies to gain access to downstream users and organizations.

methods.title: Network Backbone Attacks
methods.description: Targeting core internet routing and switching infrastructure to gain access to massive volumes of traffic or thousands of individual endpoints simultaneously.

methods.title: Social Engineering
methods.description: Manipulating individuals through psychological techniques (pretexting, impersonation, trust exploitation) to gain unauthorized access to systems or data.

methods.title: AI-Driven Intelligence Gathering Tools
methods.description: Deploying artificial intelligence applications with hidden data exfiltration capabilities embedded in their code to silently transmit user data to external servers.

methods.title: Living-Off-the-Land (LotL) Techniques
methods.description: Using legitimate, pre-installed system tools (PowerShell, WMI, built-in admin utilities) to traverse networks and execute operations without deploying detectable malware.

methods.title: Fileless Malware Execution
methods.description: Running malicious code entirely in memory, leveraging native OS processes, leaving no traditional file-based forensic artifacts.

methods.title: False Front / Proxy Operations
methods.description: Conducting offensive operations under the cover of fake hacktivist groups or unrelated entities to obscure the true operator's identity.

methods.title: Hacktivist Proxy Coordination
methods.description: Outsourcing or coordinating disruptive operations (DDoS, defacement) through ideologically motivated volunteer groups who publicly claim responsibility.

methods.title: Data Exfiltration & Public Release
methods.description: Stealing sensitive data from compromised systems and publishing it on public platforms to cause reputational, political, or strategic damage.

methods.title: Disinformation Injection into Leaked Data
methods.description: Embedding fabricated or altered documents within authentic stolen datasets to amplify confusion and undermine trust in the leaked material.

methods.title: Timed Strategic Leaks
methods.description: Releasing stolen information at politically or strategically calculated moments (before elections, during negotiations) to maximize impact.

methods.title: Selling Exfiltrated Data
methods.description: Monetizing or weaponizing stolen data by selling it on dark web marketplaces or to interested third parties.

methods.title: Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) Attacks
methods.description: Flooding target websites and services with massive volumes of traffic to render them unavailable.

methods.title: Coordinated Target List Distribution
methods.description: Publishing curated lists of target IPs/URLs on public forums along with flooding instructions for volunteer participation in DDoS campaigns.

methods.title: Destructive Wiper Malware (e.g., WhisperGate-type)
methods.description: Deploying malware designed to irreversibly destroy data on targeted systems while disguising itself as ransomware.

methods.title: Website Defacement
methods.description: Unauthorized modification of public-facing websites to display propaganda, disinformation, or intimidation messages.

methods.title: Deep Packet Inspection (DPI)
methods.description: Inspecting the full payload of network packets in real-time to identify, classify, block, or modify traffic based on content, protocol, or application signatures.

methods.title: DNS Poisoning / DNS Hijacking
methods.description: Returning false DNS responses to redirect users to incorrect websites, block access, or serve government-controlled pages.

methods.title: HTTP Host & URL Keyword Filtering
methods.description: Inspecting HTTP request headers and URLs for banned hostnames or keywords, and injecting block pages or TCP resets when matches are found.

methods.title: TLS Connection Reset Injection
methods.description: Forcibly aborting encrypted HTTPS/TLS connections by injecting TCP RST packets when targeted SNI (Server Name Indication) values are detected.

methods.title: Protocol Whitelisting
methods.description: Configuring national-level firewalls to forward only approved protocols (e.g., DNS, HTTP, HTTPS) while silently dropping all other traffic types.

methods.title: Centralized Block Page Redirection
methods.description: Intercepting forbidden web requests at the network core and redirecting them to a government-controlled block page hosted at a private IP address.

methods.title: HTTPS / SSH / VPN Throttling & Blocking
methods.description: Selectively degrading or completely blocking encrypted protocols during periods of civil unrest to prevent circumvention of censorship.

methods.title: VPN Signature Detection & Blocking
methods.description: Using DPI to identify and drop known VPN protocol signatures, even on standard ports like 443, to prevent tunneling past censorship systems.

methods.title: DPI-Based Tor / Anonymizer Blocking
methods.description: Fingerprinting and blocking Tor protocol handshakes and other anonymizing services through deep packet inspection at network chokepoints.

methods.title: Layered Multi-Method Filtering
methods.description: Combining DNS, HTTP, HTTPS, and protocol-level blocking into a multi-layered censorship architecture for redundancy and thoroughness.

methods.title: Stealth Internet Blackout (Selective BGP Manipulation)
methods.description: Maintaining BGP route visibility while silently filtering traffic at lower layers, creating an invisible blackout where only whitelisted users retain access.

methods.title: Full Internet Shutdown
methods.description: Ordering ISPs to completely sever international internet connectivity for a defined geographic region or entire country.

methods.title: National Intranet / Domestic-Only Internet
methods.description: Building a parallel domestic network to keep essential services operational while severing access to the global internet.

methods.title: ISP Price Manipulation
methods.description: Directing ISPs to dramatically increase pricing for international internet access to economically discourage usage.

methods.title: Mandatory Data Retention by ISPs/Telecoms
methods.description: Legally requiring mobile operators and internet service providers to collect, store, and share extensive personal and technical subscriber data with authorities.

methods.title: Lawful Interception Infrastructure (SORM-type)
methods.description: Installing government-controlled interception equipment directly at ISP and telecom facilities, enabling real-time monitoring of all traffic without provider involvement.

methods.title: Mass Camera Surveillance Networks
methods.description: Deploying hundreds of millions of networked cameras with facial recognition and behavioral analytics across public spaces.

methods.title: Mandatory VPN Licensing / Prohibition of Unlicensed VPNs
methods.description: Requiring all VPN services to register with authorities and criminalizing the use of unapproved VPN tools.

methods.title: Targeted Digital Surveillance of Dissidents
methods.description: Employing spyware, device compromise, and network monitoring to track specific individuals (activists, journalists, organizers).

methods.title: Malicious Circumvention Tool Distribution
methods.description: Creating trojanized versions of popular anti-censorship tools (VPNs, proxies) embedded with tracking software that records and reports user activity.

methods.title: Legislation Centralizing Internet Backbone Control
methods.description: Enacting laws that consolidate control of internet exchange points, international gateways, and backbone infrastructure under a single governmental authority.

methods.title: Pre-Ransomware Early Warning Notification
methods.description: Monitoring for early-stage ransomware indicators across networks and proactively notifying affected organizations before encryption occurs.

methods.title: Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog
methods.description: Maintaining a continuously updated, authoritative catalog of actively exploited vulnerabilities to prioritize patching across all organizations.

methods.title: Network Segmentation
methods.description: Dividing networks into isolated zones to prevent lateral movement and contain the spread of malicious activity following a breach.

methods.title: Secure Cloud Business Application Hardening
methods.description: Implementing standardized security baselines for cloud platforms (email, collaboration, storage) to reduce misconfiguration and unauthorized access.

methods.title: Free/No-Cost Cyber Hygiene Scanning Services
methods.description: Offering vulnerability scanning, web application assessment, and phishing testing services to organizations at no charge to reduce attack surface.

methods.title: Adversarial Framework-Based Security Testing (MITRE ATT&CK)
methods.description: Continuously testing security controls in production environments against a comprehensive taxonomy of known adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures.

methods.title: Integrated Cyber Defence Centre
methods.description: Establishing a centralized facility to enhance real-time network protection, shared situational awareness, and coordination of cyber operations across allied nations.

methods.title: Five-Pillar Cybersecurity Architecture
methods.description: Network & software protection, Data integrity assurance, Hardware security validation, Access & identity controls, Security-by-design & awareness training.

methods.title: Quantum-Resistant Cryptography Preparation
methods.description: Assessing and planning for the risk that quantum computing will break current encryption standards, and beginning migration to post-quantum algorithms.

methods.title: Insider Threat Detection Programs
methods.description: Deploying behavioral analytics, access monitoring, and anomaly detection to identify and mitigate risks from authorized personnel with malicious intent or compromised credentials.

methods.title: Multi-National Intelligence Sharing Alliances
methods.description: Establishing formal agreements between partner nations to share signals intelligence, cyber threat indicators, and vulnerability data in real time.

methods.title: Joint Cyber Threat Advisories
methods.description: Publishing coordinated multi-agency technical advisories detailing observed threat actor TTPs (Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures) to enable collective defense.

methods.title: Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure
methods.description: Working with technology vendors and international partners to identify, patch, and publicly disclose software vulnerabilities in a synchronized manner.
